scope: Backend video links containing YouTube radio/playlist parameters
finding: Metadata extraction inherited yt-dlp's playlist preference. The exact watch URL expanded to 201 radio tracks before the bot connection was attempted. Production logs independently confirm that the user's exact radio URL timed out during extraction before the bot could join.

production_evidence.source: Authenticated read-only Hugging Face Space runtime log stream for infinayazilim/discord
production_evidence.error: yt-dlp extraction failed: music extraction interrupted: context deadline exceeded
production_evidence.interpretation: The installed client's command reached Enqueue for the active voice channel. It failed before LiveKit connection; this incident was not a protocol-2 rejection.
production_evidence.concurrent_rollout: An unrelated deployment queued revision efcf15b at 12:29:19 UTC and restarted the Space at 12:31:40 UTC. A canonical single-video command attempted during this rollout did not show a joined bot; it is inconclusive because the backend was restarting. The new container later showed Running and /api/ready 200 at 12:32:21 UTC. This task did not deploy or restart it.

installed_client.observation: Read-only inspection of the installed ASAR shows legacy music requests containing only url. It lacks control-session and protocol-2 metadata. This is a future deployment compatibility constraint, not the cause shown in the original production log.

change: Pass --no-playlist during metadata extraction. A link identifying both a video and playlist selects that video; explicit playlist URLs continue to expand. Extraction/search deadlines now return MUSIC_NETWORK while preserving errors.Is(context.DeadlineExceeded); caller cancellation stays distinct. Existing URL/network guards, extractor restrictions and subprocess/output bounds remain in force.

checks.result: Passed in 2.730 seconds after the final deadline-classification change. Tests preserve wrapped error causes and distinguish caller cancellation from a provider deadline.

checks.result: Passed in 31.70 seconds. Metadata returned one track in 4.431 seconds, the bot joined and published GCM-encrypted audio, and an independent listener received 437 decrypted packets with decoded peak 0.2753. Key rotation received 337 frames with decoded peak 0.4156. Pause/resume, duplicate enqueue, queue, skip and stop passed.

cleanup: The task-specific disposable LiveKit container was stopped and auto-removed. Existing QA services were preserved.
limits: Local media tests verify exact-URL extraction/join/audio. Production evidence confirms the original request reached extraction and hit its deadline; corrected source has not been deployed by this task.

Media tests used no production credentials or YouTube account cookies. Existing browser authentication was used only to read Space status and runtime logs. No commit, push, deployment or installer publication was performed by this task.
Audible output through the installed Windows client remains unverified. The concurrent deployment and installed-client protocol compatibility must be considered before a wider rollout.
